default_style.character_identity: Use the provided seed avatar image as the only source of character identity. Keep the same character, face, silhouette, ears/tails or signature traits if present, outfit language, color logic, and overall recognizable identity. Do not invent a new body description or replace identity with text-only appearance prose.
default_style.visual_language: Clean premium anime/illustration style, vertical composition, expressive but safe, cinematic lighting, no readable text overlays, no watermark, no logo.
default_style.negative_prompt: different character, identity drift, inconsistent face, changed hairstyle, wrong species, wrong outfit core silhouette, low quality, distorted hands, extra limbs, watermark, logo, readable text, NSFW, sexualized, revealing outfit, exaggerated body, explicit body focus, horror
